tex_content.html:
Proposition
[The change-of-basepoint map is an isomorphism]

↗ def:change-of-basepoint-map 1. ch1:1.5\group Fundamental Group

$\beta _h$ is an isomorphism with inverse $\beta _{\bar h}$.

Proof

\sketch Concatenation modulo homotopy gives $\beta _h([f][g])=\beta _h[f]\beta _h[g]$. The relations $h\cdot \bar h\simeq c_{x_0}$ and $\bar h\cdot h\simeq c_{x_1}$ show that $\beta _h\beta _{\bar h}$ and $\beta _{\bar h}\beta _h$ are identities.

□
